hero.title: Fresh milk from our cows, delivered to your door every morning
hero.subtitle: A small family farm in Dhakephal delivering pure, fresh cow milk to homes in Aurangabad — no middlemen, no mixing, just honest milk.

story.title: Raised on our own farm, not a warehouse
story.body: Every liter comes from cows we raise ourselves in Dhakephal. We started by delivering to a few neighbours in Aurangabad — today it's grown into a small trusted round, still tracked by hand in notebooks and WhatsApp. This website is the next step: the same honest service, made a little easier for everyone.

how.title: Simple, like it always was
how.step1Body: Morning and evening milk, set once and change anytime.
how.step2Body: Going out of town? Skip a delivery or add extra milk anytime — we keep track.
how.step3Title: Pay monthly, the way you always have
how.step3Body: Cash or PhonePe — we keep a clear running account so there's never any confusion.

trust.title: Why families trust us
trust.point1: Our own cows, our own farm in Dhakephal
trust.point2: No mixing, no middlemen — milk reaches you the same day
trust.point3: A real person delivers to your door, every single day

pricing.title: Straightforward, no surprises
pricing.body: Milk starts from ₹100 per liter for daily morning or evening delivery. Billed monthly, just like before, no plans, no hidden charges.

contact.title: Want to become a customer?
contact.body: Call or WhatsApp us and we'll set up your daily delivery.

footer.rights: Farm Fresh Milk. A family business.
